title: How do you turn a PixelLab tileset into a reusable terrain brush in Godot?
author: Significant-Pool7968
selftext:
​

I’m making a top-down pixel-art game in Godot 4. I have a 32×32 PixelLab tileset with a grass-to-dirt edge I like: short grass tips, a darker band of textured soil, then lighter dirt.

I want to be able to click and drag to paint a trail and have the edge follow curves and corners automatically. Picking and placing each edge tile by hand would get old fast.

Has anyone gotten this working with Godot’s built-in terrain painting, or did you end up making a custom brush? I’d love to see a TileSet setup that handles inside and outside corners without obvious seams or repetition.
